from flagquantum.compiler.optimization.two_qubit_synthesis import _weyl_decomposition,_swap_register,_prepared_basis

from flagquantum.core.ir import Instruction
from flagquantum.compiler.topology import sabre
ORIGINAL=sabre._select_sabre_trials
BASIS=frozenset(('rx','rz','cz'))

def preview(program,coupling,plan):
 if any(i.metadata or i.matrix is not None or not 1<=len(i.wires)<=2 for i in program.instructions):raise ValueError('Preview requires unannotated one/two-qubit numeric gates')
 physical=[];cursor=0
 for count,index in enumerate(plan.sequence):
  while cursor<len(plan.swaps) and plan.swap_placements[cursor]==count:
   physical.append(Instruction('swap',plan.swaps[cursor]));cursor+=1
  physical.append(replace(program.instructions[index],wires=plan.placements[index]))
 assert cursor==len(plan.swaps)
 physical.extend(Instruction('swap',(left,right)) for left,right,_ in sabre.plan_restore_swaps(plan,coupling))
 native=[]
 for instruction in physical:
  if instruction.name in BASIS:native.append(instruction);continue
  leaves=translate(instruction,can_run=lambda i:i.name in BASIS,z_rotation='rz',pulse_opcode='rx')
  if leaves is None or any(i.name not in BASIS for i in leaves):raise ValueError('Unsupported preview lowering')
  native.extend(leaves)
 lowered=replace(program,instructions=tuple(native));estimate=sum(i.name=='cz' for i in native);basis=_prepared_basis('cz')
 for pair,positions in _collect_blocks(lowered,lambda index,pair:_numeric_matrix(native[index],pair) is not None,identity_reader=_numeric_matrix):
  block=[native[index] for index in positions];before=sum(i.name=='cz' for i in block)
  if before<2:continue
  matrix=_product(block,pair,matrix_reader=_numeric_matrix)
  if matrix is None:raise ValueError('Nonnumeric block')
  after=basis.entangler_count(_weyl_decomposition(_swap_register(matrix)))
  estimate-=max(0,before-after)
 return estimate

def select(program,coupling,baseline,*,cost=None):
 incumbent=ORIGINAL(program,coupling,baseline,cost=cost)
 if cost is not None or not incumbent.swaps:return incumbent
 start=time.perf_counter();best=incumbent;best_cost=preview(program,coupling,best);incumbent_cost=best_cost
 swap_limit=sabre._restored_swap_count(incumbent,coupling);candidates=[]
 for seed,layers in ((0,False),(1,False),(2,False),(None,True)):
  candidate=sabre._plan_sabre_trial(program,coupling,initial_layout=baseline.initial_logical_to_physical,tie_rng=random.Random(seed) if seed is not None else None,committed_swap_limit=swap_limit+1,layer_lookahead=layers)
  if candidate is None or sabre._restored_swap_count(candidate,coupling)>swap_limit:continue

 trace.append({'source':program.content_hash,'incumbent_cz':incumbent_cost,'selected_cz':best_cost,'seconds':time.perf_counter()-start,'candidates':candidates})
 return best
workflow._select=select

for case in itertools.product((6,8,12),('qaoa','ising','hopping','qft','repetition'),('line','ring','grid','sparse')):
 trace.clear();start=time.perf_counter()
 result=workflow._application(*case,'flagquantum-target-artifact',Path('/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121'))
